guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：高反射雷射鏡片
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: High-reflectivity laser mirrors
guides.concept: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
guides.conceptEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.
procedure: 雷射鏡的反射率不是「越接近 1 越好」的單一數字，而是 1 − R = T + A + S 三項的總和：穿透 T 由膜堆的導納決定，可以靠加層數無限壓低；吸收 A 由材料的消光係數與膜內場分佈決定；散射 S 由基板與膜層的粗糙度與缺陷決定。離子束濺鍍的 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 鏡可以把 A 與 S 各壓到 1 到 5 ppm，所以 T 低於幾個 ppm 之後再加層數已無意義，規格應改寫成「T ≤ 10 ppm、A ≤ 2 ppm、S ≤ 3 ppm」而不是「R ≥ 99.999%」。腔內功率數十 kW 的系統裡，幾個 ppm 的吸收就是數十 mW 的熱，這是損耗帳必須分項的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高反射堆前方的入射波與反射波形成駐波，進入膜堆後逐對衰減。以高折射率層結尾的四分之一波堆在空氣界面是波節，場強最大值落在第一個 H/L 界面，之後每深一對就乘上 (n_L/n_H)²，所以吸收與損傷幾乎都由最上面幾對決定。奈秒脈衝的損傷由缺陷吸收引發熱爆裂，飛秒脈衝則由多光子與雪崩游離主導，門檻隨材料能隙上升：SiO₂ 約 9 eV、HfO₂ 約 5.6 eV、Ta₂O₅ 約 4 eV、TiO₂ 約 3.3 eV，因此高損傷門檻鏡用 HfO₂/SiO₂，最低吸收鏡用 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡片的散射下限由基板粗糙度決定，膜層會複製基板的形貌。雷射鏡基板通常是熔融石英或低膨脹玻璃，經超拋光到 0.1 到 0.2 nm RMS，表面品質達 10-5 等級，並在潔淨室中清洗後立刻進入鍍膜腔。基板上任何殘留微粒在厚膜堆中會長成倒錐形的節瘤缺陷，節瘤直徑隨種子直徑與膜厚的乘積開平方增長，而節瘤邊界的場強集中使局部損傷門檻遠低於無缺陷區，所以損傷統計往往是由缺陷密度而非材料本質決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射鏡幾乎都以離子束濺鍍沉積：氬離子束轟擊 Ta 或 Ta₂O₅ 靶，濺出的原子帶著數 eV 能量到達基板，形成緻密、非晶、低散射的膜，腔內通入氧氣維持氧化物的化學計量，否則缺氧的 TaOₓ 會帶來 ppm 以上的吸收。沉積速率只有約 0.1 nm/s，一片 41 層、6 µm 的鏡需十幾小時，過程中靶材老化與氧分壓漂移都會改變折射率。鍍後在數百度退火可以降低吸收與機械損耗並釋放部分壓應力，是重力波探測器鏡片與高精度腔鏡的標準工序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

分光光度計的絕對精度約 0.1%，等於 1000 ppm，對雷射鏡毫無用處。損耗必須用光腔衰盪量測：把兩片鏡組成光腔，注入雷射後突然關斷，腔內光強以指數衰減，時間常數由腔長與鏡片總損耗決定，測時間比測光強準得多。吸收另以光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折量測，把泵浦雷射造成的微小熱膨脹與折射率變化轉成訊號，校正後可達 0.1 ppm；散射以總積分散射儀收集半球內的散射光。三者分別量測再相加，才是完整的損耗帳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

損傷門檻依 ISO 21254 以 1-on-1（每點一發）或 S-on-1（每點多發）測試，在多個能量密度各打數十點，統計損傷機率對能量密度的曲線，把機率外推到零得到門檻，並記錄波長、脈寬、光斑大小、重複率與損傷判定方法。門檻隨脈寬在奈秒熱擴散區近似以平方根縮放，隨波長近似線性，光斑越大掃到缺陷的機率越高而門檻越低；這些縮放只是估計，跨越物理機制（例如進入飛秒區）時完全失效。工程上以高斯光束的峰值能量密度與門檻比較，並留二到五倍的安全係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。系統端把每片鏡的損耗代入腔的往返損耗，計算精細度與腔內功率增益，確認與設計一致。交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A laser mirror's reflectance is not a single number to push toward 1 but the sum 1 − R = T + A + S: transmission T is set by the stack admittance and can be driven down without limit by adding layers; absorption A by the materials' extinction coefficients and the field distribution inside the stack; scatter S by substrate and film roughness and defects. Ion-beam-sputtered Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ mirrors reach A and S of 1 to 5 ppm each, so once T is below a few ppm further layers are pointless, and the specification should read T ≤ 10 ppm, A ≤ 2 ppm, S ≤ 3 ppm rather than R ≥ 99.999%. With tens of kilowatts circulating in a cavity, a few ppm of absorption is tens of milliwatts of heat, which is why the ledger must be itemised. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The incident and reflected waves in front of a high reflector form a standing wave that decays pair by pair inside the stack. A quarter-wave stack ending in a high-index layer has a node at the air interface, the field maximum sits at the first H/L interface, and each deeper pair multiplies the intensity by (n_L/n_H)², so absorption and damage are governed almost entirely by the top few pairs. Nanosecond damage is initiated by defect absorption and thermal explosion, while femtosecond damage is dominated by multiphoton and avalanche ionisation whose threshold rises with band gap: about 9 eV for SiO₂, 5.6 eV for HfO₂, 4 eV for Ta₂O₅ and 3.3 eV for TiO₂, which is why high-threshold mirrors use HfO₂/SiO₂ and lowest-absorption mirrors Ta₂O₅/SiO₂. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A mirror's scatter floor is set by substrate roughness, which the film replicates. Laser-mirror substrates are usually fused silica or low-expansion glass superpolished to 0.1 to 0.2 nm RMS with 10-5 surface quality, cleaned in a clean room and loaded into the chamber immediately. Any residual particle on the substrate grows through a thick stack into an inverted-cone nodular defect whose diameter scales as the square root of seed diameter times film thickness, and field concentration at the nodule boundary makes the local damage threshold far lower than defect-free film, so damage statistics are often governed by defect density rather than intrinsic material limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Laser mirrors are almost always deposited by ion-beam sputtering: an argon-ion beam strikes a Ta or Ta₂O₅ target, the sputtered atoms arrive with several eV and form dense, amorphous, low-scatter films, and oxygen is admitted to keep the oxide stoichiometric, since oxygen-deficient TaOₓ brings absorption above ppm. The rate is only about 0.1 nm/s, so a 41-layer, 6 µm mirror takes well over ten hours, during which target ageing and oxygen-pressure drift alter the index. Post-deposition annealing at several hundred degrees lowers absorption and mechanical loss and relaxes part of the compressive stress, a standard step for gravitational-wave-detector mirrors and high-precision cavity mirrors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A spectrophotometer's absolute accuracy of about 0.1% equals 1000 ppm and is useless for laser mirrors. Loss must be measured by cavity ring-down: two mirrors form a cavity, the laser is switched off abruptly, the stored light decays exponentially with a time constant set by cavity length and total mirror loss, and time is measured far more accurately than intensity. Absorption is measured separately by photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection, converting the tiny thermal expansion and index change produced by a pump laser into a signal with 0.1 ppm resolution after calibration; scatter is collected over a hemisphere by a total-integrated-scatter instrument. Only the three measured separately and summed form the complete ledger. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Thresholds are tested per ISO 21254 in 1-on-1 (one shot per site) or S-on-1 (many shots per site) mode: tens of sites are irradiated at each of several fluences, damage probability is plotted against fluence and extrapolated to zero probability, and wavelength, pulse width, spot size, repetition rate and the damage criterion are recorded. In the nanosecond thermal-diffusion regime the threshold scales roughly with the square root of pulse width and roughly linearly with wavelength, and larger spots find more defects and give lower thresholds; these scalings are estimates only and fail completely when the physics changes, as in the femtosecond regime. Engineering compares the Gaussian beam's peak fluence with the threshold and keeps a safety factor of two to five. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used. Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band. The system side enters each mirror's loss into the cavity round-trip loss to compute finesse and intracavity power build-up and checks them against the design. The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 規格只寫 R ≥ 99.99% 並以分光光度計驗收，實際鏡片吸收 50 ppm，在 20 kW 腔內功率下吸收 1 W，熱透鏡使模態失穩，鏡片在數小時後損傷。
衰盪腔內有高階橫模同時振盪，衰減曲線成為多指數，擬合得到的 τ 偏短，鏡片損耗被高估三倍而誤判不合格；或以分光光度計的 99.95% 讀值當作合格證據，實際損耗根本無法分辨。
pitfallsEn: A specification of only R ≥ 99.99% verified by spectrophotometer passes a mirror absorbing 50 ppm; at 20 kW circulating power it absorbs 1 W, thermal lensing destabilises the mode and the mirror fails after hours.

Higher-order transverse modes oscillating in the ring-down cavity make the decay multi-exponential, the fitted τ is short and the mirror loss is overestimated threefold, rejecting a good part; a spectrophotometer reading of 99.95% taken as evidence proves nothing about ppm loss.

guides.scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高反射雷射鏡片
history.text: 1960 年 Maiman 的紅寶石雷射以鍍銀端面作鏡，數年內介電多層膜取代金屬成為雷射鏡的標準；1980 年代為了環形雷射陀螺儀的 ppm 級損耗，離子束濺鍍被發展成雷射鏡的主流製程，1994 年 Szipőcs 與 Krausz 等人提出的啁啾鏡把色散控制帶入超快雷射。重力波探測器把要求推到極限：LIGO 與 Virgo 的測試質量鏡以 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 多層膜達到次 ppm 吸收，並把鍍膜熱噪聲列為靈敏度極限之一。損傷門檻測試先後由 ISO 11254 與 ISO 21254 標準化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Maiman's 1960 ruby laser used silvered end faces as mirrors, and within a few years dielectric multilayers replaced metal as the standard; in the 1980s ion-beam sputtering became the mainstream laser-mirror process to reach ppm loss for ring-laser gyroscopes, and in 1994 Szipőcs, Krausz and colleagues introduced chirped mirrors that brought dispersion control to ultrafast lasers. Gravitational-wave detectors pushed the requirements to the limit: the LIGO and Virgo test-mass mirrors use Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ multilayers with sub-ppm absorption and treat coating thermal noise as one of the sensitivity limits. Damage-threshold testing was standardised first by ISO 11254 and then by ISO 21254. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
